known_flaky_test.name: test_mem_guard
known_flaky_test.note: Pre-existing, unrelated (tools/membrane-kv-exact-sim, untouched by Phase 12H) test that reacts to REAL host swap pressure by design -- flakes on this shared, memory-constrained host when swap usage is genuinely elevated. Not a Phase 12H regression; documented in this project's own memory notes from prior phases too. UPDATE (review-fix pass): this host was under genuinely heavy, unrelated memory pressure while re-running the full gate matrix after the review fixes (MemAvailable ~735 MiB, several GiB of swap in use, multiple concurrent build/session processes) -- test_mem_guard was observed FAILING in this specific state, consistent with its documented by-design behavior, not a new bug. All ctest counts above are reported EXCLUDING this one test; every other test in every configuration passed. Re-verify test_mem_guard in isolation once host memory is available again before treating its earlier all-green status as re-confirmed.
